title: Period expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the period (part 1) must be correctly derived and stated as T = 3πm / (2Be).

title: X-axis distance
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the distance along the x-axis (part 2) must be correctly derived and stated as x = 3mv / (eB).

title: Radius calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula r = mv/(qB) to find the radii r1 and r2 for the two field regions, accounting for the different field strengths.

title: Half-period summation
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the full period T is the sum of the half-periods (T1/2 + T2/2) spent in each magnetic field region.

title: Trajectory geometry
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the x-axis displacement to the sum of the diameters (or twice the sum of the radii) of the two semicircular arcs.

title: Force direction analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may analyze the direction of the Lorentz force in each region to justify the semicircular paths and their connection at the x-axis.

title: Sign or field error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for the electron's charge in the Lorentz force, or confuses the field directions, leading to wrong radii or force directions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may demonstrate dimensional analysis or include correct units (e.g., seconds, meters) with their final answers.
